Review build: Need for Speed Underground for VLC

Double-click Preview-2x.cmd to open the 2x skin in a separate VLC instance.
Keep the launcher and VLT together. It saves its own review-vlcrc.ini here;
it does not replace your normal VLC preferences.

For permanent use: VLC > Tools > Preferences > Interface > Use custom skin,
select the VLT, save, restart VLC. The 1x VLT retains the original size.

Original skin: The Skins Factory / Electronic Arts, 2003.
VLC conversion: Dead Signal Interactive.

The PNG is an asset-rendered comparison, not a runtime screenshot.
Read Review-notes.md for remaining interaction and animation checks.
The 80% acceptance milestone awaits your review.
